name: web-dark-navy-serif-statement-with-faint-contour-lines
title: Dark navy banner with a centred serif sentence over faint wavy contour lines
whatItIs: A wide near-black navy field with a few faint grey wavy lines and a centred two-line white serif statement 'A cohesive product language shaped across experience, interface, and brand feel.'
whatItMeans: Quiet and thoughtful; a serif sentence on dark gives a reflective pause.
techniques: Use a single serif statement as a section break.
Add very faint contour lines for texture.
Keep the palette to navy and white.
Centre the text with generous space.

vocabulary.definition: Light serif type on a dark field.
